title: kbs doctor reports every check instead of aborting on the first board validation error
description: Biblicus on 0.36.0: kbs doctor stops at 'Error: validation failed: Biblicus-788.json: closed issues must have closed_at set' (plus 7 'parent ... does not exist') and never prints the methodology checks. Doctor is a diagnostic: it should run every check, report each failure with its section, and exit non-zero at the end if any failed. Consider a way to scope doctor to one area (e.g. kbs doctor --only methodologies). Spec first; Rust and Python identical.
